commands.name: temporal shell UT/DT
commands.command: for test_file in tests/unit/*.sh tests/dt/*.sh; do [ -f "$test_file" ] || continue; bash "$test_file"; done

commands.name: service-router shell UT/DT
commands.command: for test_file in tests/test-*.sh tests/unit/*.sh tests/dt/*.sh; do [ -f "$test_file" ] || continue; bash "$test_file"; done

commands.name: semantic gateway UT/DT
commands.command: python3.11 -m pip install '.[dev]' && PYTHONPATH=src python3.11 -m pytest -q tests --junitxml=$REPORT_DIR/pytest.xml

commands.name: CellMem pure UT/DT
commands.command: python3.11 -m pip install '.[dev]' && PYTHONPATH=src python3.11 -m pytest -q tests/unit tests/dt tests/test_database_config.py tests/test_latency_logging.py tests/test_runtime_start.py --junitxml=$REPORT_DIR/pytest.xml

commands.name: AgentLink UT/DT
commands.command: python3.11 -m pip install -r requirements.txt && PYTHONPATH=src python3.11 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' -v

commands.name: semantic schedule UT/DT
commands.command: python3.11 -m pip install '.[dev]' && PYTHONPATH=src python3.11 -m pytest -q tests --junitxml=$REPORT_DIR/pytest.xml
